text: やられる　なんて　なさけないわ

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a verb holds the thing up with surprise or disgust, like 'to think that'. やられる　なんて = 'to think I'd get beaten'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the thing is done to you by someone else. やられる = 'get beaten'.
